task_input_descriptions.answerer:
Task video description:
A wide, low-angle view of a large body of water under a hazy, pale blue sky, with a distant cityscape and hills on the horizon. The scene begins in darkness before fading in to reveal the water. A large, white, multi-deck passenger ferry with red life rings and the text "TURCO" on its side enters from the left, moving right across the frame, creating a white wake. The camera then cuts to an interior shot from inside the ferry, looking out through a large open doorway. Six silhouetted people stand at the railing, looking out at the bright turquoise water and distant shore. The people are dressed in casual clothing, including a plaid shirt, a white tank top with a green skirt, and a red shirt. The lighting is backlit, creating strong silhouettes against the bright exterior.
